name: views_minimap
scene: A minimap: the red and green boxes on the grey floor seen from 2.4 up and 5 back of the red box, and in the top-right corner (48x48 from x = 80) a camera 40 up looking straight down with -z up (fov 0.5) that also draws a yellow marker above the red box on render layer 1, which the main camera leaves out; white sun, no shadows; 128x128, 4x multisampling, no tonemapping, no bloom.
